title.zh: 光伏：一个光子能换多少电
title.en: Solar Cells: How Much Electricity Can One Photon Make

desc.zh: 太阳光照在一片硅上，为什么单结最多只能拿到大约三分之一？七个可以拖动的模型：太阳光谱、禁带取舍、肖克利–奎伊瑟极限、伏安曲线与发热、钙钛矿叠晶硅、电网消纳与储能、斯旺森学习曲线，以及截至 2026 年 11 月的行业前沿。
desc.en: Sunlight hits silicon, so why does a single junction turn at most about a third of it into electricity? Seven interactive models: solar spectrum, bandgap tradeoff, Shockley-Queisser limit, I-V curve and heat, perovskite-silicon tandems, grid curtailment and storage, Swanson's learning curve, plus a November 2026 frontier.

desc.zh: 5778 K 太阳黑体穿过 1.5 倍大气层后定标为 1000 W/m²（AM1.5G）；可见光只占约一半能量，大量光子落在近红外波段。
desc.en: A 5778 K solar blackbody filtered through 1.5 air masses is standardized at 1000 W/m² (AM1.5G); visible light is only about half the power, with vast photon flux in the near-infrared.

title.zh: 禁带宽度与热化/透射取舍

desc.zh: 低于禁带的光子直接穿过，高于禁带的光子把多余能量瞬间热化成晶格振动；硅 1.12 eV 最多把约 48% 的太阳能量留在带边。
desc.en: Photons below the bandgap pass straight through, while photons above it dump excess energy into heat within a picosecond; silicon (1.12 eV) keeps at most ~48% of sunlight at the band edge.

desc.zh: 细致平衡要求吸光体同时发射黑体光子，叠加熵增与填充因子损失，单结电池在 1 个太阳下的效率极限被锁在约 33%–34%（1.34 eV）；硅考虑俄歇复合后约 29.4%。
desc.en: Detailed balance forces any absorber to emit blackbody photons back out; together with entropy and fill-factor losses, single-junction efficiency caps near 33%–34% at 1 sun (1.34 eV), and ~29.4% for silicon with Auger recombination.

zh: 为什么光伏效率只有二十多
en: why are solar panels only 22% efficient

title.zh: 光伏伏安曲线、填充因子与温度系数
title.en: Solar cell I–V curve, fill factor and temperature derating

desc.zh: 单二极管电路里的串联与并联电阻削去最大功率矩形，高温令暗电流指数上升，每升高 1 °C 硅电池开路电压降约 2 mV、效率跌约 0.3%–0.4%。
desc.en: Series and shunt resistance eat into the maximum-power rectangle, while rising roof temperature drives dark current up exponentially, cutting Voc by ~2 mV/K and efficiency by ~0.3%–0.4%/K.

desc.zh: 用宽禁带顶电池吸收蓝绿光子、让红光透进硅底电池，把双结理论极限推高到约 44%–45%；两端串联（2T）要求顶电池禁带调到约 1.70–1.73 eV 实现电流匹配。
desc.en: Stacking a wide-bandgap top cell for blue photons over silicon for red photons raises the two-junction ceiling to ~44%–45%; monolithic 2-terminal stacks require ~1.70–1.73 eV top gaps for current matching.

title.zh: 光伏并网弃光与储能配比
title.en: Solar midday curtailment and battery pairing

desc.zh: 光伏正午集中出力而用电晚高峰在日落后，装机倍增而不配储能会让大量午间电力被迫弃掉，晚高峰依然需要调峰与长时储能。
desc.en: Solar peaks at midday while peak demand arrives after sunset; scaling panels without storage forces heavy midday curtailment while leaving evening peaks intact.

zh: 为什么装了光伏还要火电

title.zh: 斯旺森学习曲线与系统平衡成本

desc.zh: 全球累计光伏每翻倍组件降价约 20%–22%；当组件跌破 $0.20/W 后，支架、土地、逆变器与人工（BOS）占去大头，高效率反而成为降本钥匙。
desc.en: Each doubling of cumulative PV cuts module price by ~20%–22%; once modules fall below $0.20/W, area-scaled BOS (racking, land, labor, inverters) dominates total capex, making efficiency pay again.

title.zh: 光伏行业前沿（2026 年 11 月）

desc.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：全球光伏逼近 3 TW（2025 年新增 ~698 GW）；n 型 TOPCon/HJT 商业组件均效 22.7%；单结硅纪录 28.29%（ISFH）、钙钛矿/硅叠层 35.5%（ESTI），商业化关键卡在 25 年户外稳定性。
desc.en: As of Nov 2026: global cumulative PV nears 3 TW (~698 GW added in 2025); n-type TOPCon/HJT average 22.7% commercial module efficiency; c-Si record 28.29% (ISFH) and perovskite-Si tandem 35.5% (ESTI), with 25-year field stability remaining the commercial gate.
